name: Cádiz (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Cádiz (Hercules between two lions and the columns on blue, within a wreath, inscribed).
history: Municipal flag of Cádiz; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Cádiz arms — Hercules between lions and the columns, within a wreath
